name: Editor Collab
description: Build levels together in real time with your friends.

server-url.name: Server URL
server-url.description: Where the Editor Collab server is. Only the host needs this - joining with an invite fills it in automatically. You can also change it in the Collab popup.

display-name.name: Display Name
display-name.description: Name other people see. Leave empty to use your GD account name.

sync-interval.name: Sync Interval (seconds)
sync-interval.description: How often changes are sent and received. Lower is snappier, higher is lighter on big levels.

show-peers.name: Show Other Players
show-peers.description: Show a marker where each collaborator's camera is.
